content_sections.heading: About Lakshadweep Department of Planning, Statistics & Taxation
content_sections.text: The Department of Planning, Statistics & Taxation of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep works from the Secretariat, Kavaratti - 682555. This post is part of the State Support Mission of NITI Aayog. The Mission aims to strengthen the UT's planning system with multidisciplinary technical support for evidence-based policymaking, sustainable development, governance reforms and national development goals.

content_sections.heading: Lakshadweep Transport Sector Expert Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: One of the following: Master's Degree in Shipping Management, Maritime Studies, Port and Shipping Management, Maritime Transport, or Logistics and Supply Chain Management, or MBA/Post Graduate Diploma in Management with specialisation in Shipping, Maritime Management or Logistics. Candidates also need considerable field experience in the shipping and maritime transport sector, gained after obtaining their highest qualification. Preference will be given to candidates with an advanced diploma or degree in Shipping, Maritime Management, Port Operations, Maritime Transport, Logistics or a related field, and to those with published research papers or publications in the relevant field. Minimum 5 (five) years of experience relevant to the job description (mandatory). Demonstrated experience in leading teams, managing projects and conducting stakeholder engagement. Experience from internships or training will not be counted. Preferred: work experience in the transport sector and in implementing programmes. Experience in stakeholder management Experience in carrying out research and preparing policy briefs Experience in drafting reports and reviewing detailed project reports Knowledge of and experience in National/State planning Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Desirable: prior experience with the Government, UN agencies and other international organisations Excellent spoken and written English, skills in the State-specific language, and a proven ability to communicate well in a multi-cultural environment. For the full eligibility conditions for this post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Duties and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Maintain coordination among the UT Planning Department, LKI and NITI Aayog. Assist the State Institution for Transformation (SIT) in achieving its objectives in collaboration with NITI Aayog and LKI. Evaluate existing strategies, methodologies and systems to improve the socio-economic conditions of the UT. Prepare development strategies, sectoral targets, socio-economic goals and the UT Vision@2047, with a roadmap for achieving them. Draft policy briefs, presentations and other relevant documents. Coordinate with development partners and the technical agencies concerned. Support ways to strengthen horizontal and vertical coordination within the Government. Work with UT officials to prepare project proposals for the UT Government to implement. Assist the UT in strengthening its innovation ecosystem and its monitoring and evaluation ecosystem. Create and facilitate cross-learning platforms, and document the SIT's activities and good practices. Support the preparation of UT-level, regional and sectoral reports on a regular basis. Support regular updates on the UT's progress through the dashboard/portal maintained by NITI Aayog. Support the organisation of workshops and other SIT events, including preparing the relevant inputs. Perform any other tasks assigned by the supervisor (Team Leader) in the interest of the Mission.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of engagement: purely contractual Contract period: an initial period of two years Place of posting: Kavaratti, Lakshadweep Leave: 18 days in the whole year, plus the holidays listed by the UT of Lakshadweep government Reporting: to the supervisor (Team Leader)

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. The Transport Sector Expert is hired on a purely contractual basis for an initial period of two years under the State Support Mission of NITI Aayog.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply if I am exactly 50 years old?
faq.answer: No. You must be below 50 years of age on the advertisement date, 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Does an MBA qualify?
faq.answer: Yes, but only an MBA/PGDM with specialisation in Shipping, Maritime Management or Logistics. You also need considerable field experience in shipping and maritime transport gained after your highest qualification.

faq.question: Q4. Does internship experience count towards the 5 years?
faq.answer: No. The notice says internship and training experience will not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What should the email subject line be?
faq.answer: Use "Application for the Post of Transport Sector Expert under State Support Mission of NITI Aayog." Write the same words on the envelope if you apply by post or by hand.

faq.question: Q6. Where do I send a postal application?
faq.answer: Send it to the Director, Department of Planning, Statistics & Taxation, Secretariat Building, Kavaratti, Lakshadweep - 682555, by registered post or by hand.

faq.question: Q7. How much leave does the post carry?
faq.answer: You get 18 days of leave in the whole year, plus the holidays listed by the UT of Lakshadweep government.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents go with the application?
faq.answer: Send a detailed bio-data, a recent passport-size photograph, and self-attested copies of certificates for your qualifications, experience and age, along with the filled Application Format.

faq.question: Q9. Who will the Transport Sector Expert report to?
faq.answer: The expert works under the supervisor (Team Leader) and supports the State Institution for Transformation (SIT) alongside NITI Aayog and LKI.
